n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (Kess takes you to a night-market stall with three tables, no sign, and smoke thick enough to hide the street.)

n2.speaker: kess
n2.text: Before you say anything: no, it does not look sanitary.

n5.speaker: player
n5.text: You hate when people say that.

n7.speaker: player
n7.text: (She orders for both of you in a language the vendor understands badly and she remembers perfectly.)

n9.speaker: kess
n9.text: Camera eats first on business hours.

n12.speaker: player
n12.text: (The food arrives. Kess takes one bite and stops.)

press_cb.speaker: kess
press_cb.text: And yes, before you use my own words against me, that makes it a big deal.

patience_cb.speaker: kess
patience_cb.text: You waited. So I’m trying the part where I talk before four in the morning.

n18.speaker: player
n18.text: You said the streaming was content.

n22.speaker: player
n22.text: (She rolls the skewer between her fingers.)

n25.speaker: kess
n25.text: Side gigs are translators, access lists, favors, transit logs, people who know a person who maybe saw a fox tail in an intake center two countries away.

n28.speaker: player
n28.text: (For once she does not smile after the sentence.)

n29.speaker: kess
n29.text: When our gate broke, we were together.

n31.speaker: kess
n31.text: One second I had hands on me. The next I woke up in an Earth intake hall with forty strangers and somebody writing ‘beastkin, female, approximate age’ on a clipboard.

n35.speaker: kess
n35.text: What else was I supposed to do?

choices.text: “How much of your life is the search allowed to take?”
“You don’t have to make me believe they’re gone.”

ask1.speaker: kess
ask1.text: All of it, if that’s what it costs.

ask3.speaker: kess
ask3.text: Because I’ve had the answer for three years.

ask4.speaker: player
ask4.text: And if the answer is wrong?

ask5.speaker: kess
ask5.text: Then I’ll earn enough to afford a better one.

gentle4.speaker: kess
gentle4.text: That is an extremely annoying distinction.

gentle5.speaker: player
gentle5.text: It leaves room for hope without making hope your job.

n36.speaker: player
n36.text: (The vendor brings another plate without being asked.)

n37.speaker: kess
n37.text: I used to think the follower count was temporary.

n38.speaker: kess
n38.text: Hit the number, buy the database. Hit the next number, pay the finder. Hit the next number, cross another city off.

n43.speaker: player
n43.text: What does Kess do after everything?

n44.speaker: player
n44.text: (She looks at the food, then at you.)

n45.speaker: kess
n45.text: Wow. Date was going great until that.

n46.speaker: player
n46.text: (She pays before you can reach for your Gold.)

n50.speaker: player
n50.text: (She takes the long route home anyway.)
